description: This file defines a question generator agent using a state machine workflow with validation, capable of generating individual or batch questions for a medical exam prep application. It includes class definitions, methods for workflow construction, question generation, and batch processing, and references external modules for graph management, logging, and configuration.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: TypedDict schema representing the state of the question generation workflow

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: Agent class that manages question generation workflow, including single and batch question creation with validation logic

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the state graph workflow for question generation

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Determines whether to regenerate a question based on validation results and attempt count

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a single validated question for a given chapter and difficulty

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronously generates multiple questions in batches with concurrency control
